pinPolicy.finalRule: Use the final clean pushed post-PAY-bridge pins only after Control seals the HCM semantic/path split; do not create a branch or worktree from the observed pins.

selection.auditFinding: The canonical shared audit query and immutable event envelope are reusable. The remaining uncertainty is the product=HCM UX semantic/path split, not a new HRIS audit store.
duplicateAvoidance: BASE-TFR-SYS-007 is a completed G7 slice and must not be reopened.
BASE-TFR-SYS-012 is delivered in Wave4 and must not be reused as SYS-001.
Do not duplicate dwp-platform-server audit-control persistence, query, receipt or authorization logic in an HRIS-local service.

purpose.outcome: Resolve HRIS audit source screens to the existing canonical audit event query and immutable minimized evidence contract.

primary.ownerRule: Sensitive reads, exports, commands, decisions, denials, configuration publishes and privileged support actions record one minimized local-transaction audit event.

authorization.rule: The product=HCM query is UX context only and never substitutes for server-enforced tenant, duty, population, field, purpose or SoD decisions.

boundaries.possibleChangeAfterSeparateAuthority: Control first decides whether existing shared routes close the slice with no code or allocates the smallest exact HCM entry-link/projection delta.
forbiddenArchitecture: HRIS-local audit-event database or duplicate query API
authorization inferred from product=HCM query text

migrationDecision.rule: Do not create a Platform or HRIS migration for this preflight. Any later proven schema need requires a new exact lease and Start Token.

acceptanceSummary: DEC-SYS-009 and SYS-GOLDEN-AUDIT prove that the HCM entry resolves to SHARED-API-009 and PLAT-005 without a duplicate audit store.
Tenant-negative, purpose-negative and field-projection checks fail closed without revealing audit evidence.
SoD-negative proves independent HRIS auditor access and prevents configuration authors from gaining audit authority through the HCM context parameter.
Receipt replay and pagination/filter replay remain stable, scoped and immutable.
The canonical path split preserves the shared governance application while visibly retaining product=HCM context and a safe return path to HRIS.
A complete existing implementation may close as CONFORMANCE_CLOSE_NO_CODE; otherwise only the sealed exact UX or projection delta is eligible for a token.
startTokenGates: Pin clean pushed post-PAY-bridge dwp-dev heads once.
Seal the shared governance route, product=HCM meaning, focus deep link, return path and authorization non-reliance rule.
Prove whether current shared audit runtime and frontend entry already satisfy every acceptance item.
If complete, issue a no-code closure receipt; if incomplete, allocate exact writable paths and targeted tests in a separate Start Token.

dispatchInstruction.message: Audit the shared PLAT-005 and SHARED-API-009 implementation plus the HRIS dwp-governance entry. Decide whether product=HCM semantics and the shared path already close SYS-001 or identify the smallest exact gap. Do not edit source or documentation, create a migration, branch or worktree, run broad suites, commit, push, merge, or build a new HRIS audit surface before separate Control authority.
requiredReport: if delta exists, smallest exact path and targeted-test proposal only
